expectation: Membrane/surface stain on dendritic cells and many macrophages; moderately common, scattered or clustered in stroma and immune aggregates, often with dendritic or irregular shapes, and mostly absent from tumour nests.
observed: A: bright in stromal and immune regions, dark in the nucleus-dense nests, and varies by image. B: elongated stained cells scattered in stroma. C: tumour nest mostly empty, a few cells at its edges. D: membrane ring on an irregular cell. E: a subset of HLADR+ cells, merge shows white overlap.
why: The stain picks out irregular membrane-stained myeloid cells in stroma and immune areas, spares tumour nests and overlaps a subset of HLADR+ cells, as expected for CD11c.
notes: CD11c marks irregular, membrane-ringed cells in stroma and immune aggregates and spares the tumour nests. In row E it sits on a subset of HLADR+ cells (white in the merge), the expected myeloid/DC pattern.
